## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: (1) majority of sectors are positive (consumer staples, industrials, materials, energy leading) while megacap Tech and Financials remain under pressure, and (2) leadership skewed toward chips/cyclicals (3/5 top performers are Technology) producing mixed internals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Consumer Staples lead: MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.16% | 1M: +6.12%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +9.93%). Industrials strong: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +20.55%). Sector breadth: Consumer Stpl: 9/12 positive (Sector Strength); Industrials: 9/13 positive (Internal Rotation).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials weak: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%). Communication weak: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -7.12%). Technology internally mixed with headline names under pressure; Tech sector breadth: 8/19 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.35% | 1M: +9.80%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) — single-sector tilt worth monitoring.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -7.12%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -1.18%), ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and several high-multiple Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: INTC (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%), AMAT (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%), LMT (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%). Major divergence present: AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -3.29% | 1M: +7.03%), TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -7.73%), PFE RECOVERY (1W: +2.37% | 1M: -2.04%) — tactical signals, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed internals with notable dispersion; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.10%) and GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +7.97%) contrast with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.82%) and several software names BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Tech: 8/19 positive (Internal Rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft near-term action and concentrated weakness: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -2.93%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%). Sector breadth: Financials: 4/20 positive (Sector Weakness) — credit/capex sensitivity and headline flows weighing.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/defensive lean with patchy performance; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +2.52%) while LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -4.81% | 1M: -2.75%) and ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%). Sector breadth: Healthcare: 8/15 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals and staples exposure given leadership in Industrials, Materials and Consumer Staples; reduce exposure to pressured Financials and several expensive software names. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt (chip/capital goods and materials showing strength) while remaining position-light in idiosyncratic Tech losers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.54% | 1M: +28.82%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +22.13%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +19.30%). BEARISH: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -3.82%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -9.97%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (FCX ABOVE TREND 1W: +10.86% | 1M: +26.49%) and Industrials (BA ABOVE TREND 1W: +8.95% | 1M: +20.55%) — monitor earnings/capex commentary. BEARISH: Financials (WFC BELOW TREND 1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.24%) and Communication (CHTR BELOW TREND 1W: -7.20% | 1M: -7.12%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
INTC near-term continuation above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND) to validate follow-through; NVDA support area to hold for Tech leadership continuation (ABOVE TREND); V and WFC breaches would signal deeper Financials softness (both BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BMY (+75): Phase 3 win for Camzyos — price not in this dataset view for confirmation. D (+75): Offshore wind approval — price not in dataset. MS (+60): Positive Q4 surprise for Morgan Stanley — price not in dataset; watch financials flow despite mixed price action across the group. V (+50): Visa enables Apple Pay for China — V BELOW TREND (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -5.52%) — sentiment diverging from price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MMM (-70): PFAS class-action risk — price not in dataset; headline risk confirms caution. ISRG (-50): Softer outlook — ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.48% | 1M: -3.25%) — news confirms price weakness. QCOM (-50): Tariff headlines — QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -9.97%) — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND and LMT ABOVE TREND are showing strength while MSFT, V and multiple software names are showing weakness. Key risk: major-cap divergence (AMZN CORRECTION, TSLA RECOVERY) and mixed news flow (Visa positive headlines vs. weak price) — watch for confirmed rotation or re-concentration in Tech.
